## Context

You are working on **ConvertScan (CROBOT)** — an AI-powered CRO audit SaaS. The codebase is at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT`.

**Stack:** React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui + Supabase + React Query + React Router + Recharts

**Design System (MUST follow exactly):**
- Background: `#FAFBFC` (slate-50)
- Sidebar: `#0F172A` (slate-900) — dark
- Primary accent: `#6366F1` (indigo-500) — only for CTAs, active states, score highlights
- Cards: white bg, `1px border-slate-200`, `rounded-xl`, `shadow-sm` on hover
- Font: Inter throughout
- KPI numbers: `text-4xl font-bold`
- NO gradient page backgrounds, NO heavy shadows, NO rounded-3xl
- Score colors: green (`#22C55E`) for 70+, amber (`#F59E0B`) for 40–69, red (`#EF4444`) for 0–39

**Current state:** Most pages exist (Dashboard, Scan, AuditReport, Reports, Settings, Pricing, Landing, Login, Signup, Integrations, AgentHub, Admin). Core routing and auth work.

**What I need you to build/fix — all 8 tasks:**

---

### TASK 1: "Share Your Score" Viral Feature on AuditReport page

File: `src/pages/AuditReport.tsx`

Add a "Share Score" button next to the existing Download PDF / Share Report buttons. When clicked, opens a beautiful modal (`src/components/shared/ShareScoreModal.tsx`) that:

1. Shows a branded score card preview:
   - Dark background (`#0F172A`) 
   - Big score number (e.g. "67/100") in the center with colored ring
   - ConvertScan logo text top-left
   - URL being audited below the score
   - "Get your CRO score at convertscan.ai" branding at bottom
   - Score label ("Needs Improvement" / "Good" / "Poor") colored by range

2. Two share buttons:
   - "Share on LinkedIn" → opens `https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=...` with scan URL
   - "Share on X/Twitter" → opens `https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=...` with prewritten copy like "I just audited [url] with @ConvertScan and got a CRO score of [score]/100. Find out your score: [link]"
   - "Copy Link" button → copies the report URL to clipboard with a toast

3. Use Dialog from `@/components/ui/dialog`

---

### TASK 2: AI Rewrite Section in FindingCard

File: `src/components/shared/FindingCard.tsx`

Read this file first. Add an "AI Suggestion" section to each finding card that:

1. Shows AI-rewritten copy if `finding.ai_suggestion` exists
2. For FREE plan users (check `profile?.plan === 'free'` from `useAuth()`), blur the content and overlay a lock icon + "Upgrade to Pro" button linking to `/pricing`
3. For Pro/Agency users, show the suggestion with a "Copy" button that copies to clipboard
4. The AI suggestion box should have:
   - `bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-100 rounded-lg p-4` styling
   - Sparkles icon (lucide) at the top
   - Label "AI Suggestion" in `text-indigo-700 text-xs font-semibold`
   - The suggestion text in `text-slate-700 text-sm`
   - Copy button in top-right of the box

---

### TASK 3: "Free Scan, No Login" Public Scan Flow

Currently, unauthenticated users hitting `/scan` get redirected to signup. 

**Change:** Allow unauthenticated users to see the scan form and start a scan. The scan should be handled differently:

- For unauthenticated users, after they click "Start Analysis", instead of redirecting to signup immediately, show the progress animation (simulated steps, no real API call since they're not authenticated), then after the animation completes, show a **gate wall** instead of redirecting to a real report.

**Gate wall component** (`src/components/shared/ScanGateWall.tsx`):
- Beautiful card centered on screen
- Big "Your page scored [XX]/100" with a fake/teaser score (use a random score between 45-72 to create desire)
- Blurred pillar breakdown underneath
- "Unlock your full CRO audit report" as headline
- "See all 23 issues found, AI rewrite suggestions, and exact steps to fix each problem" as subtext
- Big indigo "Create Free Account" button → `/signup?redirect=/scan&url=[encoded_url]`
- "Already have an account? Log in" link

In `src/pages/Scan.tsx`, update the `startAnalysis` function:
- Remove the early redirect to signup for unauthenticated users
- Let them proceed to the progress animation view
- After animation completes (all steps done), show `ScanGateWall` for unauthenticated users instead of navigating to the report

---

### TASK 4: Scan Usage Bar on Dashboard — Make It Gated Properly

File: `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx`

When `atLimit` (scansUsed >= scanLimit), the Quick Scan card should:
1. Show the URL input disabled/grayed out
2. Show a colored warning banner inside the card: "You've used all [N] scans this month. [Upgrade to Pro →]" in amber/red styling
3. The "Scan" button should be replaced with "Upgrade Plan" button linking to `/pricing`

Currently the behavior may not be fully polished — make sure it's clean.

---

### TASK 5: Reports Page — Card Grid Polish

File: `src/pages/Reports.tsx`

Read this file. Improve the reports card grid:

1. Each scan card should show:
   - **Score ring** (use `ScoreRing` component from `@/components/shared/ScoreRing`) prominently
   - URL favicon (use `https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=[hostname]&sz=32` as img src with Globe fallback)
   - Truncated URL
   - Score number colored by range
   - "X issues · Y critical" stat row
   - Formatted date
   - On hover: show "View Report →" and a "···" dropdown with Re-scan / Download PDF / Delete

2. Empty state should be clean with the `EmptyState` component from `@/components/shared/EmptyState`

3. Filter bar should be functional (filter by status and score range client-side using `useMemo`)

---

### TASK 6: Settings Page — Billing Tab Complete Overhaul

File: `src/pages/Settings.tsx`

Read this file first. The Billing tab should show:

1. **Current Plan Card** (`bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 to-white border-2 border-slate-200`):
   - Plan badge (FREE / PRO / AGENCY) with appropriate color
   - "X of Y scans used" with a progress bar
   - Renewal date (if pro): "Renews on [date]"
   - For FREE: big "Upgrade to Pro" indigo button
   - For PRO/AGENCY: "Manage Billing" button that calls the stripe portal hook

2. **Plan Comparison Table** (only shown for FREE users):
   - 3 columns: Free / Pro / Agency
   - Rows: Scans/month, AI suggestions, AI rewrites, PDF export, Monitoring, Integrations, White-label, API access
   - Checkmarks (green) and X marks (slate) for each

3. **Billing History** section:
   - Table with Date, Description, Amount, Status, Invoice columns
   - If no billing history: show empty state "No billing history yet"

---

### TASK 7: Pricing Page — Monthly/Annual Toggle

File: `src/pages/Pricing.tsx`

Read this file first. If the monthly/annual toggle doesn't exist or isn't working properly:

1. Add a pill toggle at the top: "Monthly | Annual (Save 20%)"
2. When Annual is selected:
   - Pro: show `$39/mo` (was `$49/mo`) with "billed $468/year" below
   - Agency: show `$159/mo` (was `$199/mo`) with "billed $1,908/year" below
3. The Pro card should have `border-2 border-indigo-500` and a "Most Popular" badge at the top in indigo
4. Each plan card should have a "Start Free Trial" CTA that calls `useCheckout` from `@/hooks/use-billing` with the appropriate price ID
5. FAQ accordion at the bottom (use `Accordion` from `@/components/ui/accordion`) with 5 questions from the strategy doc

---

### TASK 8: Landing Page — Hero URL Input is Functional

File: `src/pages/Landing.tsx`

Read this file. The hero section should have a working URL input:
1. User types a URL in the hero input
2. Clicks "Analyze Free →"  
3. If not logged in: navigates to `/scan?url=[encoded_url]` (which pre-fills the scan form)
4. The Scan page already reads `?url=` from `useSearchParams` — verify this works (it does based on the code I read)

Also ensure:
- The hero CTA button is indigo with proper hover state
- "No signup required • Free forever • Results in 30 seconds" is shown below input
- If there are any placeholder lorem ipsum texts, replace them with real copy from the strategy doc

---

## Implementation Rules

1. **Read every file before editing it** — use the Read tool
2. **Use existing hooks and components** — do not reinvent. Key hooks: `useAuth()` from `@/contexts/AuthContext`, `useScan`, `useCreateScan` from `@/hooks/use-scans`, `useScanResults` from `@/hooks/use-scan-results`, `useBilling`, `useCheckout` from `@/hooks/use-billing`
3. **Existing design tokens** — use `text-primary`, `bg-primary`, `border-border`, `text-muted-foreground`, `bg-muted` etc. (they map to the indigo design system)
4. **Import from shadcn** — all UI components from `@/components/ui/`
5. **Toast notifications** via `import { toast } from "sonner"`
6. **TypeScript strict** — no `any`, proper types from `@/types/index.ts` and `@/types/database.ts`
7. **Agent Hub pages** (`AgentHub.tsx`, `AgentWorkspace.tsx`) — do NOT touch these, they use intentional mock data per CLAUDE.md
8. **Do NOT add new routes** — work within existing route structure

Start by reading the files for each task before editing. Do all 8 tasks. Build each one completely — no half-implementations.

## What was built

**TASK 1 — ShareScoreModal** (`src/components/shared/ShareScoreModal.tsx`)
- New Dialog component with a dark-branded score card preview (slate-900 bg, animated SVG ring, score label, URL, ConvertScan branding)

- Copy Link button with toast confirmation
- Wired into AuditReport.tsx with a "Share Score" button (Medal icon) in the header action row
- `shareModalOpen` state added to AuditReport

**TASK 2 — FindingCard AI Suggestion gate** (`src/components/shared/FindingCard.tsx`)
- Added `useAuth()` to check `profile?.plan`
- For Pro/Agency users: shows the full AI suggestion with Copy button (unchanged behavior)
- For Free users: blurs the suggestion text with CSS `blur-sm` and overlays a Lock icon + "Upgrade to Pro" button linking to `/pricing`
- Styling updated to `bg-indigo-50 border-indigo-100` per spec

**TASK 3 — Free Scan Gate Wall** (`src/components/shared/ScanGateWall.tsx`, `src/pages/Scan.tsx`)
- New `ScanGateWall` component: teaser score ring, blurred pillar breakdown, lock overlay with "Create Free Account" CTA
- `generateTeaserScore()` produces a stable hash-based score 45-72 from the URL
- Scan.tsx: unauthenticated users now run a full simulated animation (all SCAN_STEPS), then see the gate wall instead of being redirected immediately
- Button text changed to "Analyze Free — No Sign Up Needed" for guest users
- `guestAnimating` / `guestAnimationDone` state drives the flow without any API calls

**TASK 4 — Dashboard Quick Scan at-limit state** (`src/pages/Dashboard.tsx`)
- When `atLimit === true`: disabled grayed-out URL input, amber warning banner "You've used all N scans this month. Upgrade to Pro →", "Upgrade Plan" button linking to `/pricing`
- When not at limit: existing `UrlInput` renders normally with tags

**TASK 5 — Reports card grid polish** (`src/pages/Reports.tsx`)
- Added Google favicon (`https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=...&sz=32`) with Globe SVG fallback on error
- Score label below the ScoreRing with `getScoreColor()` applied
- "X critical" text uses red color with dot separator
- Filter bar was already functional with `useMemo`

**TASK 6 — Settings Billing tab overhaul** (`src/pages/Settings.tsx`)
- Current Plan Card: gradient background, colored plan badge (indigo for Pro, violet for Agency, slate for Free), scan usage progress bar with color thresholds, renewal date, "Manage Billing" button for paid plans, full-width "Upgrade to Pro" button for free users
- Plan Comparison Table (only shown for free users): 8 feature rows, checkmarks/X marks, Pro column highlighted in indigo
- Billing History: clean empty state with CreditCard icon for free users

**TASK 7 — Pricing page toggle** — Already fully implemented in the existing code (monthly/annual Switch, Save 20% badge, Most Popular badge, Pro card with `ring-2 ring-primary/20`, FAQ Accordion, comparison table). No changes needed.

**TASK 8 — Landing page hero** (`src/pages/Landing.tsx`)
- Updated button text to "Analyze Free"
- Updated subtext to "No signup required · Free forever · Results in 30 seconds"
- `UrlInput` already navigates to `/scan?url=...` which Scan.tsx reads from `useSearchParams`
